---

eldest daughter of Edward Augustus Freeman

She married (1878) Sir Arthur John Evans (1851-1941), archaeologist [ODNB Freeman and Evans]; she contributed to MP (1882). Either she, or possibly her sister Florence, took part in the Spider competitions under the name ‘Pisa’.
